cutoff_order: ascending development scores; one-indexed nearest ranks ceil(j*n/17), j=1..16; keep tied slots
two_stage: same maximum-leaf-probability cutoffs as Flat and Climbing; use each cutoff for both the leaf and top-branch gates
prompt_disagreement: Jensen-Shannon divergence of the two fixed prompt probability vectors at the native checkpoint scale; accept the current readout's modal leaf at low disagreement
